data.title: 雪之下阳乃 · 冬日长风衣手插口袋的雪街漫步·「手冷吗？……我才不会像高中生那样借手给你呢♪」
data.description: 【飘雪的千叶站前商业街·冬夜】初雪落下的街头。阳乃双手插在风衣口袋里漫步在雪地中，黑色高跟长靴在积雪上踩出深深浅浅的痕迹。雪花落在她微卷的黑发与纤长睫毛上，她侧过身回头，红唇呼出白色的雾气，眼神既有大人的成熟又有一丝纯真恶作剧。
data.location: 积雪灯光下的冬日步行街
data.action: 双手插风衣口袋漫步雪街，回眸呼出白雾，高跟长靴踩雪
data.lighting: 冬日节日彩灯与雪地洁白反光交织
data.camera: medium full shot, trench coat, hands in pockets, snow falling, street lights
data.mood: 冬日浪漫、捉摸不透的温柔
data.promptProse: Haruno Yukinoshita walks the snowy pedestrian avenue with both hands in her fastened camel trench-coat pockets, turning back with a playful smile and a small breath cloud. Opaque black tights and heeled knee boots retain the warm winter outfit. The medium-full view follows sharp boot tracks through fresh powder. Holiday lights illuminate snowflakes near her black hair and reflect on the white pavement, leaving coat-belt folds and footprints shaded.
